text: Could you make an ad for the bottle in this pic, keeping the bottle looking like mine? I’m a little worried it might end up looking like a different bottle once it’s turned into an ad. I’d like a clean studio look with a few moving close-ups, and the video should be 15 seconds long in vertical 9:16 format. For the words on screen, start with “Your everyday bottle” and end with “Shop now”. Please use mellow music with no talking.
